purpose: confirm the already frozen L4 mean-return finalist and L6 robustness finalist without selecting a new historical winner

fixed_roles.L4_add_flat20: primary-objective shadow finalist because it had the highest registered iteration-3 net20 mean
fixed_roles.L6_add_g5_all: robustness shadow finalist because concentration and top-day-removal diagnostics were stronger

required_audits.iteration3_multiplicity: shared circular 5-session blocks, 5000 samples, max candidate-minus-K0 centered mean statistic, one-sided 80% family-wise lower bounds for all 14 registered iteration-3 alternatives
required_audits.temporal: monthly, four fixed blocks and candidate-minus-control uplift in each block
required_audits.coefficients: monthly standardized Ridge coefficients and sign fraction for flat20/G5
required_audits.invariance: replace July-2025 scoring labels/returns with +/-99; scores and top2 keys must be exact
required_audits.pnl: manual fixed two-sleeve daily arithmetic must match package at 20/40/60bp
required_audits.errors: write best/worst daily cases and high-score losses to a CSV

common.target: within-training-date open-close return percentile mapped to [-1,1]

decision.L4_mean_role_retained_if: implementation and audit invariants pass; otherwise no mean finalist
decision.L6_robustness_role_retained_if: implementation and audit invariants pass; otherwise no robustness finalist
decision.multiplicity_interpretation: negative adjusted uplift lower bound forbids a superiority claim but does not erase a predeclared robustness substitution
decision.stop: after this audit, stop retrospective target/model tuning because no unused outcome remains
